instruction: I work late at night and want to reduce eye strain. Can you enable night light mode to make the screen warmer?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling night light mode via gsettings. The setup disables night-light-enabled, and the task asks the user to enable it. Evaluator verifies the setting is changed to true using exact_match metric with vm_command_line getter.
metadata.verification: Verified by checking gsettings color night-light-enabled pattern - the setting is a boolean that should be toggled from false to true.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts night-light-enabled state via gsettings command
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares result with expected value using rules['expected']
Expected value 'true\n' matches the actual gsettings command output format including newline
Evaluator provides complete coverage of the instruction requirement (enable night light mode)
No postconfig needed as gsettings state persists after changes
Parameter handling is correct: exact_match receives rules dict directly when expected.type='rule'
